verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation, compliance, and bookkeeping service, not a workflow-automation platform. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-authored automations is outside its product category. Its 'automated filings' are vendor-run services, not automations that users build and manage, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
